pages.title: Bulk Stone
pages.text: The bedrock of the higher-dimensional Bulk: a grey stone that seems to have more surfaces than it shows. Edges blur where the extra dimensions curl back in. It is cool and unremarkable to the touch, which is somehow worse.

$(thing)Notebook$()$(br)Everything in the Bulk rests on this stone, and I first broke some off to see if the extra dimensions would follow it home. They did, a little - enough to make it useful in crafting.

Made in $(item)Graviton Condenser$().$(br2)$(thing)Unlocked by$(): Brane Cosmology.$(br2)$(thing)Used in$(): Dilaton Crystal, Hyperdimensional Pearl, Kaluza-Klein Shard, Moduli Crystal, Void Lattice Shard.
